breaking.change: The built-in components' parts named for what they show now also name their role, as a part list (`part="ArenaRoster.portrait ArenaRoster.picture"`), so they wear the role rules and tokens: ranks, states, tiers, places and the like are labels; scores, prices, counts, times and stats are figures; portraits, avatars, jackets and art are pictures; skill, item, tile and choice buttons are cells; team, round, banner, grid and board panels are plates; tracks, magazines, meters and trails are wells. A selector written `[part="ArenaRoster.portrait"]` no longer matches those parts, and their default look follows their role.
breaking.fix: Reach a part with `::part(ArenaRoster\.portrait)` or `[part~="ArenaRoster.portrait"]`; restyle it through its role's tokens (docs/ui.md §3.2).
